highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 and makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit.
highlights_body: The collected engine updates correct clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback. Changes after Preview 1 additionally address reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection and affected Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

bullets.lead: Skia m157 with raster and GPU fixes
bullets.detail: Updates to m157 with corrections for convex-path rasterization, coverage-mask clamping, glyph replay validation, Graphite clipping and alpha-to-RGBx readback. The engine update preserves the existing managed binding surface.

Reflected transforms no longer enlarge zero-length square-capped hairlines, and rounded text-atlas indices avoid selecting the wrong sampler. Ganesh and Graphite defer affected device-loss cleanup for ARM proprietary Vulkan driver versions 42 through below 56.
Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify the same cdecl convention as DllImport and callback paths, correcting an ABI mismatch on Windows x86 without changing public APIs or native exports.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Introduced Skia m157 with clipped-path, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes. Generated LibraryImport declarations explicitly select cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without a native engine upgrade.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and an unchanged public API surface. Its generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl, matching the existing DllImport convention.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz version.
